draft.subject: A quick hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Just checking in as you get started with Wrenfield. The simplest path is one real project with a few tasks 
- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring in the team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
